scheme_name: Subsidy for the Purchase of Fiber-reinforced Plastic Cattamaran/ Vallam/ Wooden Nava/ Marine Plywood Canoe With Nets
other_conditions: Applicant must be enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co‑operative Society
Applicant must not have received Old Age Pension from the department
Applicant must not be employed in any Government/Government Undertaking/Fishermen Co‑operative Society
Applicant must have no dues payable to the Department or Fishermen Co‑operative Societies
Applicant must have resided continuously in Puducherry for at least five years
Male applicants must have at least five years of sea‑fishing experience in mechanized or traditional crafts
Female applicants must have at least five years of fish‑trade experience certified by the Village Panchayat
Applicant must be ready to deposit 50 % of the cost of the craft and net with the appropriate Federation/Marketing Union/Fishermen Co‑operative Society
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 50 % of the cost, with a maximum of ₹5,000 to ₹1,00,000 per unit depending on the type of craft.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
